headline: Curlews return to nest at Kent reserve where they hatched
summary: Birds from previous releases have paired up and returned to Elmley Nature Reserve, in a boost for the at-risk species.
script: Rare curlews have returned to nest at the nature reserve where they hatched. Thirty-three birds were released this year on the Isle of Sheppey, and earlier releases have now come back to raise their own young.
imageAlt: A curlew walks across a field of yellow grass at Elmley Nature Reserve.
imageAltTwo: Curlew keeper Simon Higgs stands in a field with a bird enclosure behind him.

sources.title: Curlew revival continues at Elmley nature reserve in Kent
